desc:
🥚 Welcome to Split Rock for Eggs!

How to Play:
💪 Train to gain Strength + Speed  
🪨 Split rocks to uncover eggs  
🥚 Crack open eggs to reveal pets  
🏃 Outrun the guards back to your plot  
💰 Earn money from your pets  
⬆️ Upgrade to split bigger rocks  
🔄 Rebirth to unlock powerful multipliers and boost your progress  
✨ Discover rarer eggs and more powerful pets!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
